description: This file defines an interface `PartitionInterface` for representing a section of the AWS cloud, including methods for retrieving partition names, checking region matches, fetching available endpoints, and being invokable as an endpoint provider.

classes.name: PartitionInterface
classes.description: An interface that specifies methods for AWS cloud partition operations such as retrieving the partition name, checking if a region belongs to it, fetching available endpoints, and being invokable as an endpoint provider.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the short name of the partition, e.g., 'aws', 'aws-cn', or 'aws-us-gov'.

methods.name: isRegionMatch
methods.description: Determines if the given region and service are part of this partition.

methods.name: getAvailableEndpoints
methods.description: Returns a list of endpoints supported for a given service, including non-regional endpoints if specified.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Allows the partition to be used as an invokable endpoint provider, taking an array of arguments.
